name: Industrial and Labor Relations (BS)
college: School of Industrial and Labor Relations
totalCreditsNote: 120 credits: at least 86 in the requirements above, with the rest (typically about 30) as general electives in Additional Space. PE doesn't count. Confirm with ILR Student Services.
footnote: Test credit counts toward the 105 letter-graded credits. Transfer and study-abroad credit counts toward that total only if originally letter-graded. At most 12 AP, IB, or GCE test credits apply to the degree; additional AP work is for placement only. CASE credit is outside that cap. Test and transfer credit cannot both be awarded for an equivalent course. First-year entrants may apply at most 15 non-Cornell credits, including test and outside college credit. After matriculation, all students are limited to 15 extramural credits (summer or winter elsewhere); approved study abroad is exempt from these limitations. Total transfer credit, including test and approved study-abroad credit, cannot exceed 60. These limits require manual review. The saved page states no work-hours or practice requirement. University conduct requirements must be satisfied; pending formal complaints can delay the degree, and outstanding financial obligations can delay the diploma.

sections.title: Core Courses
sections.note: 40 core credits including the separate 7-credit statistics requirement. Each listed core course is 3 credits. Approved transfer equivalents ECON 1110EC and ECON 1120EC may satisfy the corresponding economics requirements; equivalency approval requires manual review.

slots.label: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: ILRID 2510 / EDUC 2610
Introductory International and Comparative Labor: ILRGL 2300 / ILRGL 2350

sections.title: Statistics
sections.note: 7 credits with STA-IL, taken for a letter grade. Approved equivalent test or transfer credit may fulfill this requirement.

sections.title: First-Year Writing Seminar
sections.note: One 3-credit FWS. Writing requirements total 7.5-9 credits: FWS, a 3-credit sophomore writing seminar, and one 1.5-3-credit advanced writing intensive elective. All require letter grades. Transfer credit may fulfill writing requirements; test credit may not. SOW-IL and AWI-IL are checked across the plan so approved overlaps count once toward degree credits. Only roster-approved sections of ILRGL 2010, ILRGL 2050, and ILRLE 2400 fulfill both core and sophomore writing. Non-core ILR sophomore writing may overlap ICE-IL, QP-IL, ICL-IL, or LH-IL. Advanced writing may overlap ICE-IL only when both codes are present; it cannot also fulfill QP-IL, ICL-IL, or LH-IL. The app cannot enforce section approval, grade rules on writing checks, credit origin, or the advanced-writing overlap restriction.

sections.title: In-College ILR Advanced Electives
sections.note: At least 24 credits of the 40 advanced elective credits. All courses here require letter grades. QP-IL, ICL-IL, and LH-IL each require 3 credits, checked across the plan. Non-ILR courses used for those specific requirements count as in-college credit; other non-ILR courses count as out-of-college credit. The app cannot determine which specific requirement a course is being used for. Approved ILR exchange: up to 15 in-college credits for one semester. Approved credit internship: up to 12 in-college credits for a semester. No test credit. Transfer credit cannot count here except approved coursework fulfilling QP-IL, ICL-IL, or LH-IL. Across both advanced elective sections, at most 8 credits of approved independent or directed study may count; honors thesis and credit internships are exempt. Program type, approval, transfer origin, and the research cap require manual review.

sections.title: Remaining Advanced ILR Electives
sections.note: Complete the remaining 16 of 40 advanced elective credits with more in-college credits or up to 16 approved out-of-college credits, including at most 12 OCL-IL language credits. Place at least 24 in-college credits in the section above. All 40 may be ICE-IL. In-college credits here must be letter-graded; the app cannot apply that rule selectively. The app caps out-of-college credits here but cannot combine in-college credit across the two sections. No test credit; approved transfer credit may count toward OCE-IL or OCL-IL. Approved Global Learning Programs may supply up to 9 out-of-college credits for one semester or 15 for a full year. The program and independent-study caps require manual review. Non-ILR QP-IL, ICL-IL, or LH-IL courses count as in-college only when used for those requirements; classify them manually if they also carry out-of-college codes.

constraints.label: Out-of-college credits
constraints.reason: At most 16 out-of-college ILR elective credits count

constraints.label: Language credits
constraints.reason: At most 12 out-of-college language elective credits count

sections.title: Physical Education
sections.note: Two PE classes plus the swim test, a university requirement. PE credits do not count toward the 120.

checks.title: Sophomore Writing Seminar
checks.missText: Needs one SOW-IL course of 3+ credits, taken for a letter grade. See writing notes for overlap limits.

checks.title: Advanced Writing Intensive Elective
checks.missText: Needs one AWI-IL course of 1.5+ credits, taken for a letter grade. See writing notes for overlap limits.

checks.title: Science and Technology
checks.missText: Needs 3 credits with SCT-IL. Must be letter-graded; approved equivalent test or transfer credit is allowed. Grade and equivalency approval require manual review.

checks.title: Quantitative Policy Elective
checks.missText: Needs 3 credits with QP-IL. Must be letter-graded and count within the in-college advanced electives. Cannot also fulfill advanced writing.

checks.title: International and Comparative Labor Elective
checks.missText: Needs 3 credits with ICL-IL. Must be letter-graded and count within the in-college advanced electives. Cannot also fulfill advanced writing.

checks.title: Labor History Elective
checks.missText: Needs 3 credits with LH-IL. Must be letter-graded and count within the in-college advanced electives. Cannot also fulfill advanced writing.
